The best horror games on PS Plus

PS Plus has a deep bench of horror, from big-budget survival horror to slow-burn indie dread. These are our ten favourites right now, and each one says what kind of scary to expect, whether that's jump scares, creeping atmosphere or monsters you can fight back against. The full list of horror games follows.

1

Resident Evil Village

First-person survival horror · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 84 · about 9.8 h main story

Ethan Winters searches a snowbound European village for his kidnapped daughter, and runs into a castle of vampires, beasts in the woods and much worse. Some stretches are more action than horror, but the ones that go for scares are pure nightmare fuel, above all a certain house in the hills.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

2

The Evil Within 2

Third-person survival horror · PS4 · Metascore 76 · about 13 h main story

Detective Sebastian Castellanos plugs back into STEM, a shared nightmare world, to find his daughter in a small town that's tearing itself apart. It pairs tense stealth and scarce ammo with grotesque monsters and a few unforgettable villains, and its open areas let you choose how much danger to walk into.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

3

Outlast 2

Run-and-hide horror, no combat · PS4 · Metascore 75 · about 7.2 h main story

A journalist searching for his wife in the Arizona desert stumbles into a murderous cult, armed with nothing but a camcorder and its night vision. You can't fight back, only run and hide, and it never lets up. It's also extremely graphic, so it's strictly for adults.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

4

The Last of Us Part II Remastered

Survival horror with stealth · PS5 · Metascore 93 · about 23 h main story

Ellie's quest for revenge across a ruined Seattle is scarier than the first game: darker places, nastier infected, and stealth sections where one mistake brings everything down on you. One hospital basement in particular is among the most frightening stretches in any game. It's a heavy, violent story too.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

5

Until Dawn (2015)

Interactive slasher movie · PS4 · Metascore 79 · about 8 h main story

Eight friends spend a night in a remote mountain lodge, and something is hunting them. Every choice you make can save a character or get them killed, so it's built to be replayed. It's like starring in your own slasher movie, and it's great fun with friends calling out the choices.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

6

Still Wakes the Deep

Story-driven horror, no combat · PS5 · Metascore 74 · about 4.6 h main story

It's 1975 on an oil rig in the North Sea, and something has come up from below. You're an ordinary electrician with no weapons, just a desperate need to get home. The strong Scottish voice acting and the storm-battered rig make it hugely atmospheric.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

7

Crow Country

Old-school survival horror · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 84 · about 5.4 h main story

It's 1990, and you're investigating an abandoned theme park with a dark secret. Crow Country is a loving tribute to the PS1 survival horror classics, with puzzles, limited ammo and creepy low-poly visuals, but it's far friendlier than the games it imitates.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

8

Metro Exodus

Survival shooter with horror · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 80 · about 16 h main story

Artyom and his comrades flee the tunnels under Moscow on a steam train, crossing a ruined Russia full of mutants, bandits and things lurking in the dark. Between its open areas come tight, claustrophobic stretches where your gas mask filter and a flickering light are all that stand between you and something horrible.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

9

Call of Cthulhu

Investigation horror, little combat · PS4 · Metascore 63 · about 8.1 h main story

In 1924, a private investigator travels to a remote island off the New England coast to look into a painter's mysterious death. The deeper he digs into the island's secrets, the more his grip on reality slips. It's rough around the edges, but its creeping Lovecraftian dread is the real thing.

PlayStation StoreMetacriticTrailers on YouTubeOpen on the wall

10

Killer Frequency

Comedy slasher, no combat · PS4 / PS5 · Metascore 82 · about 5.1 h main story

You're a late-night radio DJ in a small 1980s town, and the emergency line has been rerouted to your booth just as a masked killer starts picking off the locals. You help callers survive over the phone, in a game that's as funny as it is tense.

Questions

What's the scariest game on PS Plus?

It depends what scares you. Outlast 2 is the most relentless, since you can't fight back at all. For a slow build of dread, try Still Wakes the Deep or Call of Cthulhu. Resident Evil Village has some of the best-made scares in the series.

Are there horror games without combat?

Yes. Outlast 2, Still Wakes the Deep and Killer Frequency have no fighting at all, and Until Dawn is mostly about choices and quick reactions.

What's a good horror game to play with friends?

Until Dawn is great with a group passing the controller and arguing over every choice. Our couch co-op and online co-op lists have games to play together properly.

What's a good horror game for beginners?

Crow Country is a friendly way into classic survival horror, and Killer Frequency is more funny than frightening. Dredge, a fishing game with a dark side, is spooky without being overwhelming.

Are the classic Resident Evil games on PS Plus?

Yes, in PS Plus Premium: the original Resident Evil, Resident Evil 2 and Resident Evil 3: Nemesis, all from the PS1. Resident Evil Village is in the Extra catalogue.

Are there short horror games?

Crow Country, Killer Frequency and Still Wakes the Deep each take around 5 hours, and so does Bramble: The Mountain King, a dark fairy tale from our short games list.
